sources.title: Microsoft Agent 365 overview
sources.note: Defines commercial availability, per-user licensing, eligible subscriptions, and Microsoft 365 E7 inclusion.

sources.title: Choose an Agent 365 integration option
sources.note: Separates built-in integration, registry sync preview, and developer SDK integration. Inventory synchronization does not supply runtime instrumentation.

sources.title: Agent roles and permissions
sources.note: Describes governance and reader roles. Prefer AI Administrator for supported governance operations.

sources.title: Microsoft 365 agent registry
sources.note: Supplies current Registry navigation and separate publisher, platform, and channel classifications.

sources.title: Copilot Studio licensing and subscriptions
sources.note: A free trial supports creation and testing, not publication. The Teams-included plan has different capabilities.

sources.title: Create a Copilot Studio agent
sources.note: Documents the standard-harness quickstart, knowledge configuration, and test panel.

sources.title: Configure Copilot Studio end-user authentication
sources.note: Teams and Microsoft 365 channels require Authenticate with Microsoft in the documented configuration.

sources.title: Publish a Copilot Studio agent to Teams and Microsoft 365
sources.note: Documents channel setup, personal Teams installation, organization approval, and the Start over conversation command.

sources.title: Copilot Studio observability integration
sources.note: Describes automatic telemetry and authenticated-session, multitenant, agent-name, truncation, and redaction limits.

sources.title: View agent details and activity
sources.note: Documents Details, Permissions, Data & tools, Certification, and Activity. Its Activity support list differs from Studio guidance.

sources.title: Deploy a Foundry hosted agent
sources.note: Documents azd 1.27.1+, provisioning roles, the basic Responses sample, and remote source-code builds.

sources.title: Foundry integration with Agent 365
sources.note: Distinguishes prompt and hosted agents. Hosted activity collection requires Agent 365 SDK configuration.

sources.title: Publish Foundry agents to Teams and Microsoft 365 Copilot
sources.note: Defines publication roles, active-version selection, Direct publish, audience options, and the public-network restriction.

sources.title: Configure Foundry Agent 365 data collection
sources.note: Resource-level logging controls prompt agents. Hosted SDK configuration can override resource-level disablement.

sources.title: Grant Foundry Agent 365 observability permissions
sources.note: Documents agentIdentityId and Agent365.Observability.OtelWrite against Agent365Observability. Allow two to five minutes for propagation.

sources.title: Third-party Agent 365 integrations
sources.note: Separates agents, Frontier AI teammates, agent factories, and coming-soon listings. A listing is not a vendor entitlement.

sources.title: Configure agent settings
sources.note: Documents Allowed agent types and external-publisher settings.

sources.title: Manage agents in Microsoft 365
sources.note: Documents registry installation, selected-user deployment, permission review, and administrative agent actions.

sources.title: Zendesk Support Assistant for Microsoft Agent 365
sources.note: Provides eligible Zendesk plans, Teams installation, login commands, account permissions, example requests, and logout.

sources.title: Connected platforms in the Microsoft 365 agent registry
sources.note: Defines connection and manual-sync procedures, supported platforms, exact AWS permissions, and Claude workspace requirements. OpenAI is absent.

sources.title: Create and configure an Amazon Bedrock agent
sources.note: Documents console creation, service role, model, instructions, preparation, and testing without mandatory action groups or knowledge bases.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents quickstart
sources.note: Documents beta agents, environments, sessions, events, and streaming. The SDK supplies the managed-agents-2026-04-01 beta header.

sources.title: Claude Managed Agents overview
sources.note: Describes stateful beta execution. Managed Agents currently lack Zero Data Retention and HIPAA BAA eligibility.

sources.title: Manage Local Agents in Microsoft 365
sources.note: Defines Local Agents Frontier prerequisites and application-blocking matrix. Native Codex CLI and Claude Code blocking is unavailable here.

sources.title: Manage Shadow AI agents in Microsoft 365
sources.note: Documents OpenClaw discovery and application blocking. Intune propagation can affect all managed Windows devices.

sources.title: Discover local AI agents with Defender for Endpoint
sources.note: Defines Defender for Endpoint Plan 2 discovery prerequisites, inventory navigation, identity semantics, MCP configuration, and AgentsInfo hunting.

sources.title: OpenAI Codex official repository
sources.note: Provides official Codex CLI installation and supported sign-in options.

sources.title: Claude Code quickstart
sources.note: Provides official Windows installation, first use, and supported authentication arrangements.

sources.title: OpenClaw getting started
sources.note: Provides provider installation, onboarding, gateway checks, and dashboard use. Validate the selected runtime against endpoint coverage.

sources.title: Agent 365 in the Frontier program
sources.note: Documents preview terms, enrollment, licensing, and absent SLA. Its E7 requirement differs from other Frontier guidance.

sources.title: Get started with Frontier
sources.note: Documents Copilot Frontier enrollment for specific users and participating-user licensing.

sources.title: Publish a Foundry hosted agent as an Agent 365 autopilot
sources.note: Documents blueprint approval, preview seats, template consent, Teams instance creation, and autopilot publication fields.

sources.title: Foundry Python autopilot sample publication script
sources.note: Pinned source snapshot dated 2026-09-17T15:39:41Z. Source existence was checked, not deployment. Resolve the researched template-field discrepancy before provisioning.

sources.title: Defender for Endpoint AI agent runtime protection overview
sources.note: September 16 guidance separates runtime threat protection from application blocking. Claude Code and Codex CLI support prompt and tool inspection.

sources.title: Amazon Bedrock Agents Classic maintenance mode
sources.note: Agents Classic closed to new customers on July 30, 2026. Existing Agents Classic customers can continue. Existing AWS account ownership alone is insufficient.
